strategies.name: first_5m_range_break_fvg_retest_scalp
strategies.entry_summary: On the 5-minute chart, mark the high and low of the first 9:30-9:35 candle. strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop just beyond the deepest point price traded into the fair value gap, with one tick of breathing room. Take profit at a fixed 3:1 reward-to-risk target and do not actively manage the trade.

strategies.name: first_15m_range_break_fvg_limit_entry_day_trade
strategies.entry_summary: On the 15-minute chart, mark the high and low of the first 9:30-9:45 candle. On the 5-minute chart, wait for price to break one of those levels with a fair value gap, then place a limit order on the fair value gap so that a retrace into it automatically enters the trade in the breakout direction.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop at the first candle of the fair value gap pattern. Take profit at a fixed 2:1 reward-to-risk target and do not actively manage the trade.

result.enumeration_note: The video teaches two distinct but compatible strategies: a scalping FVG retest-engulfing entry off the first 5-minute candle and a day-trading FVG limit-entry off the first 15-minute candle; they differ in timeframe, entry trigger, and target/stop rules, so they are enumerated separately.
